subject: GTA VI on the Windows D3D12 runtime integration

observations.result: The maintainer reports that the Rockstar Games Presents title card now appears.
The reported load reaches the first mission’s intro. The picture stays black and the host GPU fails within seconds. The cause is unresolved.

hardwareForThisRun.scope: Machine identified by the maintainer for the five-stage report.

limitations: The five-stage count describes the scope of this report. PortWatch assigns its own milestones.
The exact tested commit and GPU driver are unspecified. The title-card observation and stage summary have no matching public run capture.
The supplied status-panel image summarizes observations. It is not a capture of the game rendering the world.
The exact cause of the black picture and GPU failure is unknown. The debug attempt ended before world entry, and gameplay frame rate and player control remain unverified.
nextEvidence: Identify the tested commit and driver and capture one uninterrupted run through the title card and world transition, including an input attempt and the observed response.

stages.detail: Accessibility, language, settings and legal screens work.
Start screen, profile and save flow work.
The load reaches the first mission’s intro.
The picture stays black. The host GPU fails within seconds. World geometry and controllable gameplay remain unverified.

engineeringTasks.result: Single-list device removal traced. The remaining defect has not been attributed.
Caller, fence and Present diagnostics distinguish failure paths and retain the fence phase. Fault attribution remains pending.
Serial build and original-file protection checks passed. The latest debug request could not enable the debug layer and reached lifecycle exit before world entry.
Fix the remaining defect once identified and verify controllable gameplay on hardware.

limitations: The guard ended the run before scheduled gameplay input.
Sampled loading FPS is not gameplay performance.
Non-silent PCM and a nonzero headset session do not verify complete gameplay sound.
No available post-burst per-process memory census established its owner; the newer runner now samples all job processes.

shaderRegression.exclusion: Separately reproduced AMD compiler access violation in structured-buffer indexed count test; test remains enabled in source.

shaderCompilerInvestigation20261125.offlineResult: Both still access-violate below 0.6 GiB job commit. New native reports identify amdxc64.dll+0x861b9f reading address0x8.
shaderCompilerInvestigation20261125.syntheticResult: Authored DXC shaders with a heap-indexed buffer size query and load reproduce the same compiler fault. Removing the load or query, or using explicit registers, compiles. Wave size and wave-read-first alternatives do not resolve it.
shaderCompilerInvestigation20261125.status: Compatible descriptor binding workaround under investigation; no gameplay fix claimed.

bufferQueryWorkaround20261125.source: Authored synthetic matrix followed by narrow query-only translation change.
